layer_text.0: CNOT q0 → q1 starts copying q0 along the top row. H on q4, q5, q6, q7 makes them the sources of the X checks.
layer_text.1: CNOT q0 → q2 finishes the copy. Had q0 been |1>, the top row would now carry X on all three qubits: that is X_L, the logical flip.
layer_text.2: The sources fan out: CNOT q4 → q0, q5 → q2.
layer_text.3: The sources fan out: CNOT q4 → q1, q7 → q0.
layer_text.4: The sources fan out: CNOT q4 → q3, q7 → q1.
layer_text.5: The sources fan out: CNOT q6 → q3, q7 → q2.
layer_text.6: The sources fan out: CNOT q7 → q3.
layer_text.7: CNOT q7 → q8 completes the fan-out: all eight checks hold and A is |0>_L. Whatever state q0 starts in, the encoder makes it the logical state.
layer_text.8: Every qubit is measured in Z. Only the checks that are Z parities can still be read.

source.noise: depolarizing noise, parameter 0.05% per one-qubit gate and 0.6% per CNOT, no readout or idle error
